{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
The '''''Gold Fortress''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|ship]] in the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] task force that participated in the [[Second Battle of Fondor]]. The crew of this ship warned [[Darth Caedus]] to stay away from the [[Bloodfin (Star Destroyer)|''Bloodfin'']] as he was trying to rescue his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Tahiri Veila]].
